knowledge_gaps: The proposed invariants cannot detect every listed fault: consistently incorrect readout or item mapping can preserve batch permutation, candidate permutation, repeatability and reload equivalence. Each fault needs a specified independent reference and detection rule.

Mutation activation on witness users does not establish activation on evaluation users. Sensitivity denominators must distinguish active evaluation cases from inactive or equivalent cases without selecting cases using the detector itself.

With at most 32 users per category before partitioning, uncertainty may be substantial. User bootstraps cannot measure variation across fault implementations and can give misleadingly narrow intervals when all outcomes coincide.

Exact mutations, partition sizes, tolerances, fault severities, export interfaces and runtime limits remain unspecified. The difficulty rating of 5 may underestimate integration work; potential 7 is provisional because synthetic-fault detection has no demonstrated connection to better experiment selection or HR@10.

follow_up_queries.reason: Identify independent checks for faults that preserve the proposed metamorphic relations and avoid shared implementation errors between reference and predictor.
follow_up_queries.query: In mutation testing and metamorphic testing of sequential recommender systems with causal convolutions such as NextItNet, which independent test oracles detect incorrect endpoint readout on left-padded sequences, inconsistent item-ID mappings, and exported-predictor scoring errors when batch permutation, candidate permutation and checkpoint reload equivalence still pass? Include differential testing, mapping round-trip checks and common-mode oracle failures.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the sensitivity denominator and quantify uncertainty without treating repeated user cases as independent fault implementations.
follow_up_queries.query: How should machine-learning mutation-testing studies distinguish equivalent mutants, inactive mutants, behavioral infection and observable detection on held-out test inputs? For four fault classes evaluated on at most 32 users per recommender category, what denominators and confidence intervals are appropriate when cases share users and a single mutant, including zero-miss or zero-false-alarm outcomes?

follow_up_queries.reason: Check whether the proposed audit offers value beyond its existing checks and support realistic novelty, potential and implementation ratings.
follow_up_queries.query: What empirical evidence shows that mutation scores or metamorphic fault-detection coverage in recommender systems predict detection of real implementation bugs or improve debugging decisions? Examine the 2024 Information and Software Technology study DOI 10.1016/j.infsof.2024.107410 and related work for fault operators, threshold selection, independent evaluation mutations, runtime overhead and limitations of synthetic-fault validity.
